question: Do baryon-derived local lens Jacobians and source-to-caustic margins predict which tiny P0554 route/softness changes create or delete the apparent MACS1931 image root, and was the prior one-seed root status physical or numerical?
diagnostic_hypotheses: A genuinely fragile image branch should have a small minimum Jacobian singular value, small image-to-critical-curve distance, and small source-to-caustic margin.

If formulas classed as failed by the observed-position seed have the same globally searched image multiplicity as successful formulas, the prior status was a numerical basin diagnostic rather than image creation.
If global multiplicity changes with the formula and the disappearing matched branch approaches zero caustic margin, the topology interpretation survives.

evaluation.geometry_source: archived eight-start fits from the frozen 18-formula route/softness interaction
evaluation.source_positions_source: training-profiled source positions archived with the raw predictions
evaluation.assignment: Hungarian minimum-distance assignment from every observed family-2 image to unique globally searched roots

cross_domain_controls.galaxy: Reuse exact 131-SPARC scores for the unchanged 18 formulas.
cross_domain_controls.derived_cluster: Reuse exact 20-CLASH scores for the unchanged 18 formulas.
cross_domain_controls.solar: Reuse analytic Cassini, Earth, Saturn, and Mercury proxies for the unchanged 18 formulas.
cross_domain_controls.raw: Reconstruct all 18 formulas in all five raw clusters and diagnose all 324 held-out formula-image rows.

interpretation_rules.physical_multiplicity_change: At least one formula has fewer unique accepted family-2 roots inside the frozen aperture than another, and the observed family cannot be assigned one-to-one without reuse.
interpretation_rules.not_a_physical_multiplicity_change: Every formula has sufficient unique family-2 roots for all observed images; the old one-seed label is then a branch-placement/basin diagnostic rather than demonstrated image creation.
interpretation_rules.branch_placement_effect: Report the one-to-one assigned distance for image 2c without imposing a post-hoc success threshold; a finite but distant root is not treated as an accurate image prediction.
interpretation_rules.margin_predictive_only_within_image: Because all seven prior failures are MACS1931 image 2c, primary discrimination is restricted to the 18 variants of that one image; pooled-image AUC is diagnostic only.

claim_limits: All formulas and clusters are spent exploratory evidence.
A critical curve in the simplified radial-plus-shear lens is not the critical curve of a full multi-component cluster reconstruction.
The global search is finite and can miss roots outside the frozen 120-arcsecond aperture or between its seeds.
The member route still omits registered gas and diffuse ICL maps.
Cross-domain scores are preservation controls because this stage changes no formula.
